title: Security Fundamentals knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the purpose of “Security Fundamentals”?
options: Assume the reference output guarantees behavior across all MongoDB versions and deployment types.

Security Fundamentals should reduce unnecessary access and make connections and privileged actions reviewable. Use least-privilege roles, protected secrets, encrypted transport where configured, and a deployment-specific security checklist.
Skip validation and run the broadest possible operation immediately in production.
Disable access controls and embed connection credentials in source code to avoid configuration work.
